gold.name: gold.event_volume_daily
gold.grain: One UTC date and event type; count deduplicated silver.events.
gold.write_policy: Replace affected UTC dates idempotently; no additive append of rerun aggregates.

gold.name: gold.active_repositories_daily
gold.grain: One UTC date; count distinct repo_id in deduplicated silver.events.
gold.write_policy: Replace affected UTC dates idempotently; no additive append of rerun aggregates.

gold.name: gold.temporal_activity
gold.grain: One UTC date, UTC hour and event type; count deduplicated silver.events.
gold.write_policy: Replace affected UTC dates idempotently; no additive append of rerun aggregates.

gold.name: gold.repository_activity_daily
gold.grain: One UTC date and repository; actor_id identifies contributors, event_type defines counts.
gold.write_policy: Replace affected UTC dates idempotently; no additive append of rerun aggregates.

gold.name: gold.contributor_concentration_daily
gold.grain: One UTC date and repository; event share per actor_id; top share=max(share), HHI=sum(share squared).

gold.name: gold.repository_growth_daily
gold.grain: One UTC date and repository; relative_growth=(today-yesterday)/yesterday, null when yesterday is zero; threshold remains a later serving decision.
gold.write_policy: Replace affected UTC dates idempotently; no additive append of rerun aggregates.

gold.name: gold.issue_pr_relationships_daily
gold.grain: One UTC date and repository; count distinct explicit same-repository issue/PR pairs in typed payloads; link parser and supported syntax require S2 review.

rules.timestamps: Normalize to UTC; Spark TimestampType / Iceberg timestamptz; no naive timestamps. event_date and event_hour derive from created_at in UTC.
rules.payload: Serialize the raw payload object as compact, sorted-key JSON with Unicode preserved; semantic roundtrip, not byte-identical JSON. Preserve original gzip bytes in raw.
rules.identifier_policy: event_id stays an opaque nonempty string; actor_id/repo_id/org_id are positive signed 64-bit integers. org_id is null for a missing/null org or org.id.
rules.invalid_raw_policy: Reject malformed JSON and missing/invalid required bronze values; retain the raw archive. Production quarantine behavior is a follow-up; the S0 checker fails rather than silently coercing.
rules.unknown_event_policy: Accept any nonempty event_type in bronze and common silver; retain payload. Add a typed-table proposal for newly observed types during contract review; never discard an unrecognized type.
rules.dedup_scope: Silver global event_id across input files/hours; bronze keeps duplicates. Event-specific silver is filtered from deduplicated common silver.
rules.dedup_winner: Choose the earliest ingested_at, then lexical source_file, then SHA-256 of canonical JSON of all bronze event columns except ingested_at/source_file; retain conflict evidence for differing occurrences. Identical ties have identical values.
rules.partition_v1: Iceberg hidden days(created_at) for bronze/silver; identity event_date for gold. Do not partition by event_type/repo_id or hour in v1; compare other layouts later.
rules.evolution: New top-level raw fields remain in the original archive; extra payload keys remain in the string. Unknown types use common silver. Breaking common-field changes need a new contract and A+B review.
rules.ownership: A owns event extraction; B owns common silver and gold drivers; C owns runtime/catalog/serving. Proceed within the requested scope; review incidents and shared-interface changes without blocking ordinary implementation.
rules.local_cluster_parity: Same code and config key set; paths/endpoints/master/scale values vary by config. S0 checker exercises local bytes only; cluster execution is not claimed.
rules.config_encoding: Examples use the JSON subset of YAML, loadable with Python stdlib json; a general YAML loader requires a separately approved dependency.
rules.measurement_schema: results/experiments.csv uses long-form: experiment_id,run_id,recorded_at,config,source_file,metric,value,unit. Peer review is not a delivery gate.
rules.measurement_scope: Download plus gzip-validation time is separate from scan time; cache hits omit download time. No JSON-vs-Parquet, throughput-scale or cluster result is inferred.
